desc: Implement the complete Python solution using the DSU threshold-imbalance method: read the input, build diff[v] = count_A(v) - count_B(v), sort edges by weight, maintain DSU component diffs and sum_abs = Σ|diff|, and for each successful union at weight w add w * (sum_abs//2 before the union - sum_abs//2 after the union), then print the answer.
